items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: I do that at my current gig at Caffe Lena... Louie’s was usually a couple of days before but I want to get your music

ctx.x: You know even back then, and I do that at my current gig at Caffe Lena, I want your music and I want to get your music before, you know like Louie’s was usually a couple of days before but I want to get your music so — I’m not a great sight reader, I’m working on it but I want to be able to know your music well enough when we’re presenting a concert for it to sound like that. Plus I learn, man, how much you learn doing that. You get into somebody else’s head, somebody else’s trip, somebody else’s compositional…
Well you went to college after all.
